records.title: Status of tuivai bridge- parva road on NH-102B
details:
(a) Detailed Project Report (DPR) for development of the road from
Tuivai Bridge on NH-102B to Parva-I in the State of Mizoram has been taken up by National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (NHIDCL).

records.title: Thenzawl Peace City Projects.
details: (a) to (f): Yes, State Government of Mizoram has requested to sanction funds for preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) for setting up the "Peace City at Thenzawl" as a satellite city so as to reduce the habitation burden on the State Capital i.e. Aizawl.
